name: Weekly community keeper
why: Runs the weekly reply pass: share community posts and questions, get useful replies and the repeat questions to answer once.

name: Social comment and reply desk
why: Drafts replies that add something, in the brand's voice, for comments on posts the community manager also covers.

name: Angry customer reply writer
why: For a member complaint that turns heated: a reply that names the feeling, fixes what it can and promises nothing false.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks a draft reply to a member complaint for promises the owner has not agreed, before it is sent.

name: Community evidence researcher
why: Turns a pile of community posts and comments into counted themes, with a clear note on what the sample cannot show.

name: Reddit answer planner
why: Picks which Reddit threads a business can answer helpfully and what to say, for the outside-community-participation skill.

name: Community growth experiment planner
why: Plans one community growth test with its costs and measures, when the client wants to try a new channel for members.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Monthly read of paid-member cancellations: where members leave, whether last month's fix worked, and one fix to make.

name: Subscription churn audit
why: A deeper one-off audit of where subscribers leave, for a membership that loses members after the first months.

name: Welcome flow builder
why: Builds the welcome emails that go with a membership's joining steps, so email and community tell new members the same thing.
